messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High ephemeral storage pressure on node gpu-prod-04. Multiple serve-runtime pods evicted. Impact: 15% of requests returning 5xx. Trigger: kubelet eviction threshold reached (rootfs.available < 5%).
sarah (SRE): seeing repeated OOMs in modelcache on those pods, and container restart loops. attaching recent kubelet events and pod logs.
raj (oncall): oncall here, paging me now. timeline?
megan (runtime): started ~10:12 UTC with burst of model loads for overnight batch. modelcache writes + excessive log writeback filled emptyDir. logs show repeated file handle errors: 
```
E0321 10:13:02.123 1 runtime.cc:442] modelcache: failed to write segment /cache/m/b/0001: write: no space left on device
E0321 10:13:02.124 1 runtime.cc:455] open /cache/m/b/0001: too many open files
```
megan (runtime): appears to be file descriptor leak in the new async-evict path; handles not closing during certain cache miss hot loops.
lee (ml infra): cuda errors are secondary: when pod restarts it sometimes fails to init GPU and errors like `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` appear because cache state got corrupted. But root cause looks storage.
emily (support): we have a couple of customer reports about increased latency and 5xxs in that region. Are any dedicated tenants affected?
sarah (SRE): quick impact check: traffic route shows ~1200 requests/min to that cluster, ~8% error rate spike for last 30m. No enterprise dedicated customers on these nodes.
raj (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) cordon node gpu-prod-04 2) drain non-critical pods 3) restart modelcache controller with reduced fd limit and debug logging 4) roll a hotfix to close fds
megan (runtime): agree. also limit concurrent model loads to avoid hot loop. patch ready: increase close() calls + try/catch around async write. will push canary.
sarah (SRE): executing cordon + drain now. 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-prod-04
kubectl drain gpu-prod-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/modelcache@hotfix-fd-close -> canary on node pool a
raj (oncall): while drain runs, can we free up space immediately? maybe delete old logs on node?
lee (ml infra): suggest `kubectl exec` into affected pod to truncate logs and drop cache files: 
```
# on node or init container
truncate -s 0 /var/log/serve/runtime.log || true
rm -rf /cache/modelcache/temp/* || true
sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches
```
megan (runtime): doing a more surgical evict: will scale replica count to redistribute load and avoid mass cache loads to single node. `kubectl scale deploy/model-serve --replicas=6`
emily (support): posting customer update: "We're investigating a storage-induced runtime issue affecting some requests in US-west; mitigation underway. No dedicated customer data impacted"
sarah (SRE): drain completed, node cordoned. restarted pods on other nodes. monitoring metrics for 5xx.
raj (oncall): canary patch reported fewer fd errors on logs. runtime logs now show closed descriptors.
megan (runtime): stack trace removed the leak at 10:42 after canary. rolling to remaining replicas.
megan (runtime): patch diff summary: added finally blocks to close fds, added metrics for open_fds, and rate-limit on async writes.
sarah (SRE): re-checking disk pressure: free space on affected nodes back to normal. eviction count down to zero.
lee (ml infra): GPU init failures reduced after restart; apparently corruption resolved once cache files removed.
emily (support): updating customers: "Service stabilized after mitigation, we will follow up with root cause and timeline."
raj (oncall): moving to post-incident: assign owners: megan -> runtime fix + PR, sarah -> remediation playbook (disk cleanup / logrotate), lee -> add node-level alerting for fd usage, emily -> customer comms and SL release.
megan (runtime): PR opened: github.com/redwood/modelcache/pull/482. includes tests and canary results.
sarah (SRE): temporary runbook notes added to runbooks/storage-evict.md: increase eviction thresholds only with caution; prefer logrotation and emptyDir size bump.
lee (ml infra): follow-up: create a quota on modelcache temp dir via EmptyDir sizeLimit and enable lazy init for large models.
raj (oncall): will keep this thread open for 24h for regression watch. tagging for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
emily (support): I've added a summary to customer incident tracker ticket INC-2026-134.
megan (runtime): next steps: merge PR, cut patch release v1.3.2, add open_fd metric export to prometheus.
sarah (SRE): closing mitigation phase; if we see reoccurrence reopen. thanks all. :tada:"
